headline: Both chambers go pro forma to close out the week, with limited action on the floor.

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate met in pro forma session on Thursday morning, October 1, adjourning almost immediately after convening at 10:30 a.m. No votes or substantive business was conducted.

house.lastSessionSummary: The House met in pro forma session on Thursday, October 1, with minimal floor activity. Eighty public bills and 17 resolutions were introduced, and one committee report on traumatic brain injury research grants was filed, but no votes were recorded.

onTheFloor.title: Veterans Affairs grant program for traumatic brain injury and neurorehabilitation research clinical trials

committees.topic: Nomination hearing concluding for Treasury Assistant Secretary Jeremy Wiggins, HUD Assistant Secretary Matthew Jones, and Export-Import Bank officials David Slade and Michael Rigas
